title: Add configurable auto-nearby-stack interval and renamed-item exclusion toggle
body:
This PR addresses two behavior gaps in nearby sorting: there was no configurable periodic trigger for “stack to nearby containers,” and renamed items were always filtered with no user control. It introduces interval-based auto-run plus a Behavior checkbox to control renamed-item exclusion.

- **Behavior options**
  - Added `stackToNearbyContainersIntervalSeconds` (default `0`, disabled) to run nearby quick-stack every _X_ seconds.
  - Added `doNotSortRenamedItemsToNearbyContainers` (default `true`) so renamed-item filtering is explicit and user-configurable.

- **Runtime wiring**
  - Hooked interval execution into the client tick path (`MinecraftMixin#tick`).
  - Added scheduler state in `InventoryActions` to trigger only when due, reset when invalid context (no world/player or UI open), and avoid overlapping container traversal tasks.

- **Nearby quick-stack filtering**
  - Split nearby quick-stack paths from local container quick-stack paths.
  - Nearby quick-stack now conditionally skips `ItemStack#hasCustomHoverName()` based on `doNotSortRenamedItemsToNearbyContainers`.
  - Existing quick-stack/restock behavior outside nearby traversal remains unchanged.

- **Menu + localization**
  - Added Behavior-tab controls for both new options.
  - Added/updated i18n keys in `en_us`, `ru_ru`, `zh_cn`, and `zh_tw`.

```java
public static void quickStackToNearbyContainers(AbstractContainerMenu screenHandler) {
    quickStack(screenHandler, ModOptions.get().behavior.doNotSortRenamedItemsToNearbyContainers.booleanValue());
}
```
